description: The Washington Legislature's Black Members Caucus was formed in 2019.This year the members led on a number of issues, including the enactment of sweeping police accountability measures and passage of a bill that made Juneteenth a state holiday. The caucus used its collective voice to urge Gov. Jay Inslee to extend the state’s eviction moratorium...https://www.kuow.org/stories/we-have-a-voice-black-lawmakers-are-changing-the-conversation-in-olympia
